args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy of v2.3.1 to production (all regions: us-east, us-west, eu-west), with error rate at 0.18. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release, v2.3.0, in all regions. Rollback verified as rolled out. Investigating root cause of v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Both actions are complete. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy of **v2.3.1** to production (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions).

**Investigation findings:**
- Current production version: v2.3.1 (unhealthy) in us-east, us-west, eu-west
- Deployment history: v2.2.9 (healthy) → v2.3.0 (healthy) → v2.3.1-rc (unhealthy, staging) → v2.3.1 (unhealthy, production)
- The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback was verified as rolled out (human approval: "Approved. Looks right.").
2. **Opened SEV2 incident** INC-0001 for checkout-api, titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0", which paged the on-call engineer. The incident documents the rollback and flags the v2.3.1 regression for root-cause investigation.
